text: {"reactions": [{"ad": "A1", "stopped": false, "understood": true, "believed": false, "why_not": "I don't buy rice like that online and that welcome offer never seems to include delivery, wouldn't bother downloading another app for it.", "intent": "I wouldn't click, I just get rice at the supermarket.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A2", "stopped": false, "understood": true, "believed": false, "why_not": "Looks like cheap dropship stuff and I don't need a fan like that, probably noisy and breaks quickly.", "intent": "I wouldn't click or buy, not something I need.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A3", "stopped": false, "understood": true, "believed": false, "why_not": "It's women's heeled sandals which are nothing to do with me and I don't trust Temu quality anyway.", "intent": "I definitely wouldn't click, completely irrelevant to me.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A4", "stopped": true, "understood": true, "believed": false, "why_not": "Might be handy but I don't believe the 47% off claim and my kitchen is fine as it is, don't need more metal pots on the side.", "intent": "I wouldn't click to buy, maybe glance but not interested enough.", "intent_score": 2}, {"ad": "A5", "stopped": false, "understood": true, "believed": true, "why_not": "I don't want another silly phone game spamming me with ads, not my thing.", "intent": "I wouldn't click, I don't play these games.", "intent_score": 1}], "preferred": "A4"}
